issue.title: yum install httpie - not working?
issue.body:
Help?

`# yum install httpie
CentOS-8 - AppStream                                                                                                         718 kB/s | 6.4 MB     00:09
CentOS-8 - Base                                                                                                              1.4 MB/s | 5.0 MB     00:03
CentOS-8 - Extras                                                                                                            2.3 kB/s | 2.1 kB     00:00
Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux 8 - x86_64                                                                               865 kB/s | 5.6 MB     00:06

No match for argument: httpie
`

comments.author: jkbrzt
comments.body:
HTTPie for CentOS is _usually_ available in the [EPEL repo](https://fedoraproject.org/wiki/EPEL):


```bash
dnf install epel-release
dnf install httpie
```

If the HTTPie RPM package hasn’t been updated for the latest CentOS (as it currently seems to be the case with CentOS 8), you can still [install HTTPie using pip](https://httpie.org/docs#windows-etc):

```bash
pip install httpie
```
